info.description: Real-money crowd probability estimates from Polymarket for any question. Returns p_yes, p_no, 24h volume, open interest, and a directional signal. Best crowd-sourced odds available on any prediction market question.
info.x-guidance: POST /service with JSON body {"input": "Will Bitcoin hit 100k in 2025?"} where input is a natural-language question. Returns: p_yes, p_no, volume_24h, signal (bullish/bearish/neutral).

check crowd odds for a crypto price target being hit
query Polymarket probability for any yes/no event
use crowd-sourced odds as a prior in an AI agent decision
get 24h trading volume on a specific prediction market

feed real-money probability into an automated trading strategy
check open interest on a prediction market contract
use crowd intelligence to calibrate AI model confidence
